messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — HelioFoods is launching 3 new product workstreams next week (content-gen, relevance, auditing). They forecast ~3x traffic increase and want a smooth onboarding.
Jonah: Do they prefer Dedicated or hosted for the pilot? Any SLA asks? @Maya
Maya: They want predictable p95 for search and low-cost embeddings. Asking if we can do a short Dedicated pilot with an autoscale buffer.
Priya: Current metrics: avg 1.2k qps, p50 120ms. With their plan we should budget ~3.5k qps. Need prefix cache hit rate and whether embeddings will be batched.
Maya: They said embeddings will be batched client-side and each team will use separate API keys. Also asked about canary routing to a slightly newer model variant.
Ethan: We can spin up an addl pool (2 x A100-equivalent) in eu-west for a 7-day pilot. Will need CS approval for billing attach. @capacity-bot can create the ticket.
capacity-bot: Created ticket INF-5421: provision-dedicated-pool for HelioFoods (owner: Ethan). ETA: 24h.
Jonah: I'll draft an onboarding playbook + enablement workshop. Can Solutions and Eng join kickoff Wed 10:00? @Priya @Ethan
Priya: Wed 10 works. Please share sample prompt set and traffic distribution. If they run long-context docs we'll recommend quantized model variants.
Priya: Example autoscale snippet they can expect:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 6
  target_qps_per_replica: 800
```
Maya: Sending prompt set + traffic DM now. Also flag: enterprise renewal in ~8 weeks — if onboarding stalls this could become a churn risk.
Ethan: Noted. I'll add monitoring: alert if cost delta >25% or p95 latency >400ms, and an automated fallback to hosted replicas on breach.
Maya: Great. Action items: 1) approve invoice attach, 2) provision pool (INF-5421), 3) schedule solutions workshop, 4) add monitor rules, 5) update account-health doc. I'll follow up after kickoff. :+1:
